en-US.DESC_EDITOR_HORIZONTAL_PROPERTIES: Lays each level-editor inspector property out as "label [field]" on one row, instead of the label stacked above the field. Affects the in-game editor, not this settings window.
en-US.DESC_FAQ_OPEN_FILE: Opens FAQ.json in whatever your system uses for .json files, writing the default file first if it isn't there yet.
en-US.DESC_FAQ_OPEN_FOLDER: Opens the Quartz data folder that holds FAQ.json and your settings.
en-US.DESC_FAQ_RELOAD: Re-reads FAQ.json from disk and rebuilds the list below.
en-US.DESC_FONT_COUNTDOWN: Apply the selected font to the pre-level countdown ("3, 2, 1, Go!").
en-US.DESC_FONT_JUDGEMENT: Apply the selected font to the per-hit judgement popup ("Perfect!"/"Early!"). This is the rating text itself, not the counts above.
en-US.DESC_FONT_SONG_TITLE: Apply the selected font to the level title shown during play, not just this mod's UI.
en-US.DESC_IMPORT_DO: Copy this mod's settings into Quartz. Settings it doesn't cover are left as they are.
en-US.DESC_IMPORT_PROFILE: Copy this mod's settings into a new Quartz profile, leaving the current profile selected.
en-US.DESC_IMPORT_RESCAN: Re-scan for supported mods loaded through Unity Mod Manager.
en-US.DESC_JUDGEMENT_XPERFECT: Split the Perfect count into +Perfect / X / -Perfect when the XPerfect mod is active.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_COUNTFORMAT: Show counters with a thousands separator (1,234).
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_DM_CSS_IMPORT: Select a DM Note custom CSS file. Layers over the preset; restyles keys and counters.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_DM_IMPORT: Select a DM Note preset JSON file.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORT_JSON: Write the layout to a plain DM Note preset. Anything DM Note cannot express is dropped, and the export says what.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORT_QKV: Write the layout and every Key Viewer setting to a .qkv. Quartz only, and the format to use to move a layout to another Quartz install.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_FILE: Import a DM Note preset, write this layout out to a file, or rebuild it from your Simple mode settings.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_FOOT: Add a row of foot keys under this tab's layout, or change how many. They light on press but don't count toward the total.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_IMPORT: Select a DM Note preset JSON file. Replaces the layout you are editing.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_MIGRATE: Rebuild this layout from your Simple mode style, key bindings, labels and colours. Overwrites the layout you are editing.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_TAB_ADD: Add a tab holding one of the Simple mode key layouts, ready to edit.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_TAB_DELETE: Remove the tab you are editing, and every element on it.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_FOOTSTYLE: Add a separate foot-pedal element you can drag on its own in Reorganize mode. The keys light on press but don't count.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_GHOSTRAINDOTTED: Ghost rain draws as a repeating dash pattern instead of a solid streak (port of JipperResourcePack's ghost rain).
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_GHOSTSET: Click, then press the secondary (ghost) key for this slot. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_HIDEMAINCOUNT: Hide the per-key counters on the key boxes.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_KEYLABEL: Custom caption for the selected key. Leave empty to derive it from the bound key.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PERKEYKPS: Each key box shows that key's presses-per-second instead of its total press count.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_COLORSENABLE: Give just this key its own colours. The other keys keep the shared colours until you turn theirs on too.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_COPYGLOBAL: Overwrite every key's per-key colours and font sizes with the current shared values.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_COPYTHIS: Copy this key's colours onto every key and turn on separate colours for all of them.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_FONTENABLE: Give just this key its own font sizes. The other keys keep the shared sizes until you turn theirs on too.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_REBIND: Click, then press the new key for this slot. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_RAIN: Streaks rising from a key while it's held.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_RAINWIDTH: Streak width for the front key row. 0 matches each key's width.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_RESETCOUNTS: Clears every per-key press counter and the total.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_SHOWOUTSIDE: Keep the key viewer visible in menus and outside of gameplay, not just while a level is playing.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_STREAMER: Hide the KPS and Total stat boxes entirely.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_SYNCLIMITER: Overwrites the Key Limiter's allowed keys with the keys shown here, and keeps them matched when you rebind keys or switch styles.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB: Past a point in the level, note rain stops and a picture drops over the key viewer, so nobody watching can read your tapping pattern. Presses are still counted underneath, and everything returns to normal on the next attempt.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB_IMAGE: Pick your own picture instead of the one that ships with the mod.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB_PERCENT: How far into the level the picture takes over. It fades in over the second leading up to this point, and fades back out over the last second of the level.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB_SCALE: Scales the picture. Drag it into place in Reorganize mode.
en-US.DESC_MIDDLE_CLICK_TO_SET_AS_DEFAULT:
Setting that restores an item to its default value when you middle-click on it.
You can identify it by a small dot at the top-left of the item.
en-US.DESC_MODULES_INSTALL_BUNDLED: Installs this module from the copy that shipped with Quartz — no download needed.
en-US.DESC_MODULES_INSTALL_TAB: Installs every module this tab offers — the ones bundled with Quartz go in instantly, the rest download from GitHub.
en-US.DESC_MODULES_RELOAD: Unloads every module, re-scans the Module folder, and rebuilds this window. A module's code is only read from disk once per session — restart the game to pick up an updated .qmod.
en-US.DESC_MODULES_REMOVE_TAB: Deletes every module in this tab from disk. Their settings are kept, and anything in another tab that depends on them stops working until you re-install.
en-US.DESC_MODULES_UPDATE_TAB: Downloads the newer version of every module in this tab that has one. Restart the game afterwards to use them.
en-US.DESC_OUTLINE_WIDTH: Thickness of the settings window's white outlines — the border ring, the submenu column, the top rule and the bottom pane edge.
en-US.DESC_PANELS_CREATE: Adds a new empty panel. Name it, put stats on it, then drag it into place with Reorganize.
en-US.DESC_PROFILE_ADD: Creates a new profile from your current settings and switches to it.
en-US.DESC_PROFILE_IMPORT: Loads a .qprofile (or legacy .krprofile) file as a new profile. It won't be selected automatically.
en-US.DESC_PROFILE_RECALIBRATE: Re-baseline overlay positions to this monitor, keeping them exactly where they are now. Positions then scale proportionally if the profile is used on a different-sized display.
en-US.DESC_SETTINGS_FONT: Font for this mod's own settings window. "Same as overlay font" follows the Font picker above.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_CHANNEL: Which builds to receive when updating. Alpha gets new builds first and each step up is more stable, with Stable being only final releases. Updates stay in the channel you pick, so Alpha offers the newest alpha rather than a beta of the same version.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_NOTES: Opens this release's notes on GitHub.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_RESTART: Closes the game and starts it again — through Steam when the game was launched from Steam, otherwise by relaunching it directly.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_SKIP: Hides this version. You'll still be offered the next release.
en-US.EDITOR_FLIPROTATE_SHORTCUT_FLIP_V: Ctrl + Shift + L — Flip selection vertically
en-US.EXIT_REORGANIZE_TIP: Hold to move this button, middle click to reset it
en-US.FAQ_EMPTY: FAQ.json has no questions in it yet.
en-US.FAQ_ERROR: FAQ.json couldn't be read, showing the built-in questions instead — {0}
en-US.FAQ_HINT: These questions live in FAQ.json in your Quartz folder. Edit that file to reword an answer, add your own questions or drop the ones you don't need, then press Reload. Delete the file and reload to get the defaults back.
en-US.HOME_CARD_FAILED: This card failed to build — see the log.
en-US.HOME_HINT: Everything Quartz does lives in the tabs on the left. Search finds any setting by name.
en-US.HOME_SETUP_EMPTY: No modules yet — every feature lives in one. Open Modules to add some.
en-US.HOME_UPDATE_AVAILABLE: An update is available — see Settings.
en-US.HOME_UPDATE_INSTALLED: An update was installed. Restart the game to use it.
en-US.IMPORT_ERR_CREATE_PROFILE: Could not create an import profile.
en-US.IMPORT_ERR_PROFILE_SWITCH_BACK: Imported into profile, but could not switch back to the previous profile.
en-US.IMPORT_ERR_SELECT_KEYVIEWER_PART: Select at least one KeyViewer setting group.
en-US.IMPORT_HINT: Pull your settings in from another ADOFAI mod. Quartz reads each supported mod loaded through Unity Mod Manager and copies over what it has a home for. Your other settings are left untouched.
en-US.IMPORT_NONE: No supported mods detected. Load one through Unity Mod Manager — KorenResourcePack (v1), JipperResourcePack, JipperKeyViewer, ADOFAI Tweaks, KeyboardChatterBlocker, or Enhanced Effect Remover — then press Rescan.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_DMGAP_COUNT_IN_TOTAL: keys kept out of the total
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORTED_JSON_GAPS: Exported for DM Note, without: {0}. Export .qkv instead to keep them.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORTED_QKV: Exported as .qkv — the full layout and Key Viewer settings, for another Quartz install.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_IMPORTED_QKV: Imported. {0} Key Viewer setting(s) came from the .qkv and replaced yours.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_IMPORT_EMPTY: No presets found. Put a .qkv or .json in {0}
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_MIGRATE_HINT: This layout is empty. Migrate rebuilds it from your Simple mode settings.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_TAB_MAX: You already have {0} tabs, DM Note's limit.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_FOOT_HINT: The foot keys are a separate element — drag them anywhere in Reorganize mode.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_KEYS_HINT: Click a key to open its editor.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_PK_COPYTHIS: Copy This Key's Colors to All Keys
en-US.KEYVIEWER_PK_FONTENABLE: Separate Font Sizes For This Key
en-US.MODULES_ABI_BLOCKED: Built for a different Quartz — update Quartz to install this.
en-US.MODULES_CATALOG_UNREADABLE: The module catalog could not be read.
en-US.MODULES_HINT: Every feature ships as a module. Turn a tab off to hide it from the sidebar; open its page here to install, remove, or switch individual modules on and off.
en-US.MODULES_INSTALL_OFFLINE: Couldn't reach GitHub — check your connection.
en-US.MODULES_OFFLINE: Offline — showing the last catalog Quartz saw.
en-US.MODULES_UPDATED_RESTART: Updated — restart the game to apply.
en-US.PROFILE_HINT: Every setting lives in the active profile. Export a profile before updating the mod manually, then import it back if your UserData gets replaced.
en-US.PROFILE_STATUS_IMPORT_FAILED: Import failed — not a Quartz profile file.
en-US.QUIZ_MERCY: Fine. The quiz gives up on you. Go in.
en-US.SEARCH_HINT: Type to search every tab — categories, toggles, buttons, everything.
en-US.TOGGLE_BIND_HINT: Right-click any toggle to give it its own hotkey. Press Esc while binding to unbind it.
en-US.UPDATE_FAILED_NETWORK: Couldn't reach GitHub — check your connection.
en-US.UPDATE_FAILED_NOT_FOUND: Update check failed — release feed not found.
en-US.UPDATE_FAILED_RATE_LIMIT: GitHub rate limit reached — try again later.
en-US.UPDATE_INSTALLED: Update installed — restart the game to apply.
en-US.UPDATE_RESTART_FAILED: Couldn't restart automatically — close and reopen the game.
en-US.UPDATE_SKIPPED: Skipped {0} — it won't be offered again.
